title: When waiting keeps turning bitter under pressure
issueStatement: Delay has started feeding resentment instead of ripening trust. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru ties patience to listening, honor, and steadiness rather than passive resentment. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: The mind settles less by roaming and more by right company. Wait by listening instead of simmering.
actionPrompt: Wait by listening instead of simmering. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
